integrity: Forward frequency identities independently derived from the metric; explicit inverse family and sharp open bounds proved algebraically; exact symbolic and 4700 seeded numerical comparisons reproduced in a standalone checker. Forward formula and general isofrequency degeneracy are credited to earlier literature.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to two coordinate-time infinitesimal frequencies of strictly stable spinless circular geodesics in an ideal static Kottler metric with M>0 and Lambda>0. No observational clock calibration, finite-sample estimation, eccentric motion, or noisy inverse stability is established. Historically relevant 1999 primary full text was not available for inspection; priority uncertainty remains.
title: Sharp frequency feasibility and inverse fibers for stable Kottler circular geodesics
